gui.pattern_crafter.mark_input.tooltip.l: §7Click to save mark input from current inventory
§7Ctrl/Alt+Click to clear mark input without matching items
gui.pattern_crafter.crafting_mode.toolti: Both: accept shaped and shapeless recipes.
Only Shaped: accept only shaped recipes.
Only Shapeless: accept only shapeless recipes.
gui.pattern_crafter.recursive_outputs.to: Result mode: Eject — results go to machine output slots only. Crafting stops if there is no space.
Result mode: Keep — craft anyway, then merge result into inputs first; leftover (partial) goes to outputs. Repeats crafting this tick (depth limited). Crafting stops if any part would overflow.
Result mode: Smart — merge as much of the result into inputs as possible (what fits), eject the rest to outputs. No recursion. Crafting stops if any part would overflow.
gui.pattern_crafter.unused_inputs.toolti: Ingredient mode: Keep — remainders (unused inputs) are inserted into input slots first, then outputs. Crafting is blocked if they don't fit.
Ingredient mode: Eject — remainders (unused inputs) are inserted into output slots first. Crafting is blocked if they don't fit.
